The London Advanced newsletter

Useful London, only when it’s worth sending.

I do not publish to fill a schedule. I send a carefully edited note when I have genuinely useful places, routes or events to share. Some months that may be twice, occasionally three times, and never simply because another week has passed.

No spamNo daily blasts, filler or manufactured urgency.

Properly curatedSelected, checked and written by Paolo.

Actually usefulPlaces, routes and events worth saving or acting on.

You can unsubscribe with one click whenever the letter is no longer useful to you.
